description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for battery degradation simulations, including cycle, calendar, and profile aging configurations, as well as auxiliary functions for running these simulations.

classes.name: CycleAgeingConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for cycle aging simulations, including voltage, temperature, C-rate, and SOC windows.

classes.name: CalendarAgeingConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for calendar aging simulations, including voltage, temperature, and SOC.

classes.name: ProfileAgeingConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for profile (drive cycle) aging simulations, including voltage, temperature, SOC, and CSV profile name.

methods.name: Calendar_one
methods.description: Simulates one calendar aging experiment with specified parameters.

methods.name: Cycle_one
methods.description: Simulates one cycle aging experiment with specified parameters.

methods.name: Profile_one
methods.description: Simulates one drive cycle aging experiment.

methods.name: CycleAgeing
methods.description: Runs a range of cycle aging experiments across different parameters.

methods.name: CalendarAgeing
methods.description: Runs a range of calendar aging experiments across different parameters.

methods.name: ProfileAgeing
methods.description: Runs a range of drive cycle aging experiments across different parameters.

methods.name: Cycle_one (overloaded)
methods.description: Simulates a cycle aging experiment using a configuration object.
